description: For one product, compare a dealer's delivered price with every other dealer's delivered price, return its rank and gap to the lowest offer, and compare its premium over spot with the field median. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).

dealerId.description: Dealer ID or slug (e.g., 'jm-bullion', 'JM Bullion', or 'jmbullion.com').

slugOrId.description: Product slug or canonical product ID.
